title: Wall-hook bracket under load
line: A static FEA study of a steel wall-hook bracket carrying a 2 kN hanging load.
description: Static strength of a wall-hook bracket (40 x 50 x 35 mm, steel). The base plate is bolted to a wall at its three countersunk mounting holes, which are held. A two-kilonewton load hangs from the hook: it presses down the wall (-Y) on the hook seat, the upward-facing flat between the wall and the lip.
thumbnailAlt: Displacement of a steel wall-hook bracket under a hanging load, solved in RunMat
